questions.question: How many seconds are in 1 minute?
questions.explain: There are 60 seconds in 1 minute. A common mix-up is picking 7 (days in a week) or 12 (months in a year) instead of 60.

questions.question: How many days are in 1 week?
questions.explain: A week has 7 days. Watch out for mixing up 7 with 12 (months in a year) or 60 (seconds in a minute).

questions.question: How many months are in 1 year?
questions.explain: A year has 12 months. The trap is grabbing 7 (days in a week) or 60 (seconds in a minute) by mistake.

questions.question: How many days are in 3 weeks?
questions.explain: 3 weeks means 7 + 7 + 7, which is 21 days. If you used 10 per week you would get 30, and 12 per week gives 36.

questions.question: Maya waits 3 minutes for the bus. How many seconds is 3 minutes?
questions.explain: 3 minutes means 60 + 60 + 60, which is 180 seconds. Picking 21 or 36 would mean you used 7 or 12 seconds per minute instead of 60.

questions.question: Dad will be home in 2 weeks. How many days is that?
questions.explain: 2 weeks means 7 + 7, which is 14 days. Using 10 or 12 per week would give 20 or 24, but a week has 7 days, not 10 or 12.

questions.question: Lila will be at this school for 2 more years. How many months is that?
questions.explain: 2 years means 12 + 12, which is 24 months. A common slip is using 10 per year (giving 20) or 7 per year (giving 14).

questions.question: Sam is 5 years old. How many months old is he?
questions.explain: 5 years means 12 added five times, which is 60 months. If you used 10 per year you get 50, and 7 per year gives 35.

questions.question: A song lasts 2 minutes. Sam listens to 2 songs back to back. How many seconds did he listen?
questions.explain: First find the total minutes: 2 + 2 = 4 minutes. Then convert: 4 × 60 = 240 seconds. A common mistake is using 7 or 12 per minute instead of 60.

questions.question: 4 weeks = ___ days.
questions.explain: 4 weeks means 7 + 7 + 7 + 7, which is 28 days. If you used 10 per week you get 40, and 12 per week gives 48.

questions.question: 3 years = ___ months.
questions.explain: 3 years means 12 + 12 + 12, which is 36 months. Picking 30 would mean you used 10 per year, and 21 means you used 7 per year.

questions.question: Noah says, '1 week has 12 days.' What is his mistake?
questions.explain: A week has 7 days and a year has 12 months. Noah grabbed the 12 from months and put it with days, mixing up two different pairs.
